	        <div style="float:left; width:100%;" id="post-2097" class="post-2097 page type-page status-publish hentry">
	            <div class="wpb-content-wrapper"><div data-vc-full-width="true" data-vc-full-width-temp="true" data-vc-full-width-init="false" data-vc-stretch-content="true" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid w-overlay vc_custom_1659183670116 vc_row-has-fill vc_row-no-padding vc_row-o-content-middle vc_row-flex"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"> <h1 style="color:#ffffff;padding:px;text-align:center;font-size:50px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-50  ">KITE CENTER</h1> </div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row-full-width vc_clearfix"></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1657979341690 vc_row-o-content-middle vc_row-flex"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-5"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"> <h2 style="color:;padding:px;text-align:;font-size:35px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-35  ">HABAGAT KITE CENTER</h2> <div style="background-color:;height: 20px" class="nicdark_section  "></div> <h5 style="color:;padding:px;text-align:;font-size:px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="    ">KITEBOARDING SCHOOL</h5> <div style="background-color:;height: 20px" class="nicdark_section  "></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>One of the first kiteboarding schools on Boracay, Habagat Kiteboarding Center is an <strong><em>International Kiteboarding Organization  (IKO) Kite Center</em></strong> and has long been a home to kitesurfers, and a place where many have started their kiteboarding journeys.</p>
<p>Situated right on Bulabog Beach (Boracay&#8217;s Kite Beach), our guests are just footsteps away from the water!</p>
<p>We offer private kiteboarding lessons with IKO certified instructors.</p>
<p>W offer equipment rental, storage, and accommodation right on kite beach, so you are the closest to the water when the wind blows and the conditions are perfect.</p>
<p>Habagat is under German management and obliges with German standards, no less.</p>
		</div>
	</div>
	<a style="border: px solid;border-radius:px;letter-spacing:px;line-height:px;font-size:px;background-color:;padding:;margin:;color:" rel="" href="" class="nicdark_display_inline_block nd_options_float_left   global-btn "></a>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-4"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_left wpb_content_element">
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">

	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_left wpb_content_element">

		</figure>

</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-7"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"> <h2 style="color:;padding:px;text-align:;font-size:35px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-35  ">KITESURFING BORACAY</h2> <div style="background-color:;height: 30px" class="nicdark_section  "></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>One of the most famous kite destinations in Asia, Boracay Island is truly a kitesurfer&#8217;s paradise. Bulabog Beach is the main kiteboarding beach on Boracay, spanning over 1.5 kilometers long. An outer reef spans the length of the beach, which breaks the larger ocean swell, creating a massive chest-deep flat-water lagoon, which is ideal for beginners learning the sport and advanced kitesurfers looking to work on new tricks.</p>
		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"> <h2 style="color:;padding:px;text-align:center;font-size:35px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-35  ">WIND IN BORACAY</h2> <div style="background-color:;height: 30px" class="nicdark_section  "></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element text-center" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>The main kite season is during the northwest monsoon (Amihan), which spans from November through to late March, with the strongest wind between December and February. Typically winds will range between 15-25 knots during the season. During the southwest monsoon (Habagat) &#8211; kitesurfing moves to Boracay&#8217;s White Beach &#8211; which is a four-kilometer stretch of white sand. There isnt an outer reef, so conidions are usually choppy &#8211; but a welcome challenge for seasoned kiters.<br />
Check out the live forecast below.</p>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="wpb_raw_code wpb_raw_html wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<script id="wg_fwdg_576_100_1666745868008"></script>
		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1727252839870 vc_row-o-content-middle vc_row-flex"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"> <h2 style="color:;padding:px;text-align:;font-size:35px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-35  ">KITEBOARDING COURSES</h2> <div style="background-color:;height: 30px" class="nicdark_section  "></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >

			<p>Start and continue your kiteboarding education with us at Habagat Kiteboarding Center! We offer a range of courses to accommodate everyone from the absolute beginner through to advanced riders, learning with our IKO Certified Instructors.</p>

 <h4 style="color:;padding:px;text-align:center;font-size:px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="    ">Kleng Delos Santos</h4> <div style="background-color:;height: 5px" class="nicdark_section  "></div> <p style="color:;padding:px;text-align:center;font-size:px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="    ">INSTRUCTOR</p> </div></div></div></div><div id="rental" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1659186746171"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-5"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1657982015347"><div class="wpb_wrapper"> <h2 style="color:;padding:px;text-align:;font-size:35px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-35  ">KITE RENTAL &amp; STORAGE</h2> <div style="background-color:;height: 30px" class="nicdark_section  "></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>For certified kiteboarders looking to pack light on their kite holiday, Habagat Kiteboarding Center offers a selection of CORE and NORTH kiteboarding equipment for rent. You can choose to rent kites to complete your quiver on the lightwind or howling days, or rent a complete set from head to toe.</p>
<p>You can also choose to store your kite equipment with us at Habagat Kite Center, so that all your gear is stored securely right on the beach and ready for when the conditions are perfect. Equipment storage includes a caddie to set up and pack down your gear, and to help with launching and landing your kites.</p>
		</div>
